newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhs to announce tender for Emba oil concern soon.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhs to announce tender for Emba oil concern soon.

text.p: Kazakhstan will soon announce an international tender to sell a stake in Embamunaigaz, one of the Central Asian state's largest oil production enterprises, a senior privatisation official said on Monday.
"We will announce a tender for Embamunaigaz some time soon," Maksutbek Rakhanov, first deputy chairman of Kazakhstan's state privatisation committee, told Reuters in an interview.
He gave no further details, but industry sources said an announcement is expected in a few weeks.
The sources said that around 60 percent of shares in Embamunaigaz, located in northwest Kazakhstan, will be offered.
Almaty-based brokers Global Kazkommerts Securities Inc, in its Winter 1997 report, said the enterprise's oil quality is high, with proven reserves of 507 million barrels.

Embamunaigaz's 1996 crude oil production was 12.68 million barrels (253,600 barrels per day, or bpd), up from 11.97 million barrels (239,400 bpd) in 1995, and it is expected to produce 12.81 million barrels (256,200 bpd) this year.
